reasons.label: Fear
reasons.quote: Patient-related delay: From symptom recognition to seeking medical attention - Fear and anxiety

reasons.label: Costs
reasons.quote: Patient out-of-pocket costs: Fees, medicines and travel costs are more expensive and can delay investigations, reduce medication use and discourage screening.

reasons.label: Health literacy
reasons.quote: Patient-related delay: Limited health literacy (also slide 7: Health literacy - Understanding symptoms and care; Access to care - Barriers, delays and navigation)

reasons_source: H. Kuitunen, OUH: Equitable Cancer Care, 30.10.2026

age_claim.text: Half of cancers in Finland are diagnosed after about 70
age_claim.source: Tanskanen et al., Am J Epidemiol (Finnish Cancer Registry data)

digital_claim.text: 1 in 3 Finns aged 75 to 89 are not online
digital_claim.number: 64% of 75-89 year olds used the internet (36% did not)
digital_claim.source: Statistics Finland, Use of ICT by individuals 2024

narration_age: Most cancer patients in Finland are around seventy, and one in three people over seventy-five is not online.
notes: Slides do not name distance as such; travel appears only as travel costs (slide 5). Navigation appears on slides 6 and 7. Age: median is from a registry-based paper (period 2013-2017), no 65+ share found. Digital: 36% is derived as 100 minus 64; no current smartphone figure for 75-89 found, so the claim is about internet use, not smartphones.
